gloss: theater troupe; theatrical company; drama group

definitions.gloss: theater troupe; theatrical company; drama group
definitions.explanation: An organized group of actors who perform plays, musicals, or other theatrical works together. Ranges from professional companies to university drama clubs.

examples.japanese: {劇団|げきだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{劇団|げきだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げた→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧。
examples.english: I started a drama group at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{劇団|げきだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}っている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: That theater troupe holds a nationwide tour every year.

notes:
An organized group of actors that performs plays or theatrical works together. Composed of ⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧ (drama/play) + ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group/troupe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {劇団|げきだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a theater troupe
- {劇団|げきだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}げる→立ち上げる：07892_tachiageru⟧: to start a theater troupe
- {劇団|げきだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{主宰|しゅさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lead/run a theater troupe
- {劇団員|げきだんいん}: theater troupe member

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous Japanese theater troupes include {劇団四季|げきだんしき} (Shiki Theatre Company, known for musicals) and {宝塚歌劇団|たからづかかげきだん} (Takarazuka Revue, the all-female troupe). University drama clubs (⟦{演劇|えんげき}→演劇：04106_engeki⟧⟦サークル→サークル：10933_saakuru⟧) are also very popular in Japan.
